name: MERSEC
recent: Mercury Securities Group Berhad 近期主要变动为注册地址更改，以及首席人员（Principal Officer）由 MISS CHAN TZE XIN 接任。公司最新季度（截至2026年7月31日）营收环比下降10.2%，但净利润环比增长11.1%，同比营收和净利润分别增长35.3%和33.4%。
notable: 公司注册地址发生变更。
首席人员（Principal Officer）由 MISS CHAN TZE XIN 接任。
earnings: 最新季度（截至2026年7月31日）营收为8,891,973令吉，环比下降10.2%，同比增长35.3%；净利润为4,227,514令吉，环比增长11.1%，同比增长33.4%；净利润率为47.5%，高于上一季度的38.4%。

recent_en: Mercury Securities Group Berhad's recent key changes include a change of registered address and the appointment of MISS CHAN TZE XIN as Principal Officer. For the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue fell 10.2% QoQ but net income rose 11.1% QoQ, while revenue and net income grew 35.3% and 33.4% YoY respectively.
notable_en: The company changed its registered address.
MISS CHAN TZE XIN was appointed as Principal Officer.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 8,891,973, down 10.2% QoQ but up 35.3% YoY; net income was MYR 4,227,514, up 11.1% QoQ and 33.4% YoY; net margin was 47.5%, higher than 38.4% in the previous quarter.
